players.name: Carson Beck
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.summary: Coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that the Cardinals are still evaluating the status of Love (ankle), with the running back's earliest possible return from IR on the horizon, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.summary: The Ravens believe "there's a chance" that Jackson (thumb) could return for their Week 16 matchup with the Browns, assuming all goes well in his recovery from right thumb surgery, Dan Graziano of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.summary: Kincaid (thumb/ankle) was listed as a limited participant on Monday's practice estimate.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.summary: Brooks (groin) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

players.name: Roschon Johnson
players.summary: Johnson (ankle) was listed as a non-participant on Monday's estimated practice report.

players.name: Andrei Iosivas
players.summary: Iosivas (thumb) was downgraded to out for Monday's game against the Commanders, Mike Petraglia of CLNSCincy.com reports.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.summary: Boston didn't take part in the Browns' unofficial practice Tuesday, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Raheim Sanders
players.summary: The Browns designated Sanders (hip) for return from injured reserve Tuesday.

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.summary: Ferguson (knee/ankle) remained a non-participant in practice Tuesday, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

players.name: Jonathan Mingo
players.summary: questionable

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.summary: Broncos head coach Sean Payton announced Tuesday that Dobbins has been suspended one game for conduct detrimental to the team, Chris Tomasson of The Denver Gazette reports.

players.name: Caleb Lohner
players.summary: Lohner (foot) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

players.name: Sam LaPorta
players.summary: LaPorta (ankle) was limited at Monday's walkthrough, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.

players.name: Skyy Moore
players.summary: Moore (ankle) is listed as questionable for Wednesday night's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

players.name: Bo Melton
players.summary: Melton (thigh) is listed as questionable for Wednesday night's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.summary: The Packers list Jacobs (finger) as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Luke Musgrave
players.summary: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Saturday that he doesn't anticipate Musgrove (neck) returning from the PUP list this season, according to NFL reporter Jason B. Hirschhorn.

players.name: Brevin Jordan
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Woody Marks
players.summary: Head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Marks (concussion) is "trending in the right direction," and the Texans "are hopeful to have him" for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

players.name: Kayshon Boutte
players.summary: Boutte's hip injury he suffered in Thursday night's win over the Colts doesn't appear to be serious, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

players.name: Will Mallory
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Seth McGowan
players.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said that McGowan will miss some time after injuring his hamstring in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans, Stephen Holder of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.summary: Head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce continues to rehab his left heel injury, and the wideout hasn't been ruled out for a return from injured reserve before the end of the season, Nathan Brown of The Indianapolis Star reports.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.summary: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said Tuten aggravated a right ankle injury in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants, while noting that an examination Monday revealed nothing "too bad," Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.summary: The Chiefs listed Walker (groin) as a limited participant in Tuesday's practice.

players.name: Noah Gray
players.summary: Gray (ribs) was deemed a non-participant in Monday's walkthrough.

players.name: Jared Wiley
players.summary: The Chiefs placed Wiley (ankle) on injured reserve Wednesday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Dareke Young
players.summary: Young (stinger) is questionable to return to Sunday's contest against Denver.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Justin Herbert
players.summary: Herbert entered the concussion protocol after Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Keaton Mitchell
players.summary: Mitchell (back) has re-entered Sunday's game against the Jets, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.summary: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Monday that Ferguson (hamstring) won't be activated from injured reserve this season and will require surgery to address the ankle injury he aggravated in Week 3, Stu Jackson of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.summary: Adams (hamstring) has an "outside chance" to return from injured reserve for the Rams' Week 13 matchup with the Chiefs but is more likely to be activated around mid-December, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.summary: Nacua (knee/toe) is expected to be sidelined 4-to-5 months after undergoing surgery Tuesday to repair his right MCL, which means he won't be on track to return at any point during the playoffs, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Jared Wayne
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Malik Willis
players.summary: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that, at this time, surgery to address Willis' groin/core injury is not foreseen, Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.summary: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Addison is "progressing really well" in his recovery from thumb surgery, though the wide receiver isn't expected to be available in Week 12 versus the Falcons, Ben Goessling of The Minnesota Star Tribune reports.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.summary: Brown (hamstring) wasn't spotted on the field for Tuesday's unofficial practice, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

players.name: Drake Maye
players.summary: For now, Maye -- who suffered a fractured right fibula during a Week 10 loss to the Lions -- remains on the Patriots' 53-man roster rather than injured reserve, with coach Mike Vrabel citing the "balance" the team is hoping to strike with regard to managing its remaining designated to return from IR slots, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.summary: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that Doubs (shoulder) may be cleared to return to practice later in the week, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

players.name: Juwan Johnson
players.summary: Saints head coach Kellen Moore said Monday that Johnson is still undergoing further medical evaluation after injuring his hamstring during Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears, Ross Jackson of WWL-TV reports.

players.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
players.summary: Tracy (hamstring) could be reinstated from injured reserve when first eligible ahead of the Giants' Week 13 game against the 49ers, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Isaiah Williams
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Will Shipley
players.summary: Shipley (foot/illness) was estimated as a limited participant on Monday's injury report.

players.name: Tanner McKee
players.summary: McKee (ribs) was estimated as a limited participant on Monday's injury report.

players.name: Dallas Goedert
players.summary: Goedert was listed as a limited participant on Monday's practice estimate due to a shin injury.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.summary: Barkley was listed as a limited participant on Monday's estimated practice report due to a neck injury and an illness.

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
players.summary: The Eagles placed Wicks (ankle/foot) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.summary: Pittman (foot) was listed as a full participant in Tuesday's walkthrough practice.

players.name: Ben Skowronek
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Darnold (quadriceps/rib) made a "good bit of progress" over the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and will start Sunday at San Francisco if he fares well during Wednesday's practice, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: George Holani
players.summary: The Seahawks placed Holani (knee) on injured reserve Monday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.summary: The Titans placed Spears (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.
